plugins.description: A workflow + project memory layer for AI-paired engineering. Builders inherit a kata, adapt it to their project, transcend the form. Compiles business semantics (the part AI code-quality can't infer), manages spec authoring + disagreement. 13 skills (init, import, ingest, search, graph, tier, digest, query, lint, config, dream, watch, sync) on a Karpathy-style llm-wiki substrate; multi-machine git sync, multi-CLI session ingest (v1.11 in flight).
